project_type: Roblox Luau game (Pet Simulator) using procedural geometry
build_system: Python script (tools/generate_rbxlx.py) generates BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx from src/ tree
test_framework: No automated tests - validation via XML structure check of generated .rbxlx
test_command: python3 -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; ET.parse('BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx'); print('XML valid')"
verification_instructions: Run generate_rbxlx.py and validate the output XML parses correctly
snapshot_or_generated_files: BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx is regenerated from src/ via tools/generate_rbxlx.py
setup_instructions: No setup needed - Python3 is pre-installed
environment_constraints: No Roblox Studio available - validation is via XML parsing only
contribution_requirements: All changes go in src/, then regenerate .rbxlx with the Python tool
key_patterns: Server services in src/ServerScriptService/Services/, shared data modules in src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/, zone layout uses X spacing of 250 studs per zone
directory_structure: src/ServerScriptService/ (server code), src/StarterPlayer/ (client code), src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/ (shared data modules), tools/ (build tools)
